items.title: NAIL
items.description: 2026.06 Columbia (Sriraman, Liu, Hsu, Block) arXiv 2606.30923 Behavior Cloning is Not All You Need: The Optimality of OPD for Noisy Expert Feedback — proves offline BC needs samples exponential in horizon under a noisy expert (and that this is necessary for any offline IL), while OPD is polynomial; proposes NAIL

items.title: Dense Supervision, Sparse Updates
items.description: 2026.06 Nanjing Univ. / Amap Alibaba arXiv 2606.13657 On the Sparsity and Geometry of OPD — OPD updates are tiny (0.036–0.142% relative Frobenius norm) and 67–90% coordinate-sparse, concentrated in FFN; training only the discovered sparse mask nearly recovers full OPD

items.title: Rock Tokens
items.description: 2026.05 UMBC / Case Western / ASU / VU Amsterdam arXiv 2605.09253 Cornerstones or Stumbling Blocks? Deciphering the Rock Tokens in OPD — tokens keeping high KL after saturation are mostly structural scaffolding whose gradients Adam neutralizes, and are causally near-irrelevant to accuracy

White-box methods use teacher logits / log-probabilities to supervise the student on student-generated rollouts. Each entry below has been verified to (a) train on student rollouts and (b) operate at the token level.
Methods that turned out to be RL-style on verification have been moved to OPD-RL Hybrids; off-policy / pure-loss-function / pretraining-side methods are excluded from this list.

items.description: 2026.04 Meta / LinkedIn arXiv 2604.14084 TIP — Token Importance, shares LinkedIn OPSD repo with PACED

items.title: Hybrid-Policy-Distillation
items.description: 2026.04 SJTU / Shanghai Innovation Institute / Tencent arXiv 2604.20244 HPD — Hybrid Policy Distillation; LlamaFactory + verl backends (ICML 2026). ⚠️ headline Tables 2–4 use a lightweight approximation of on-policy sampling that avoids full-sequence rollouts; true on-policy results appear only in §5.4/Table 5

items.title: BRTS
items.description: 2026.05 JHU (Patel group) arXiv 2605.09725 BRTS — Best-of-N Teacher Rollout Selection; augments student-context OPD with a curated teacher-context branch (correctness-first, then student-alignment) to cut single-rollout teacher variance

items.title: FiRe-OPD
items.description: 2026.06 THU / HKUST / Meituan (Li et al.) arXiv 2606.02684 FiRe-OPD — Filter, then Reweight; decouples optimization granularity — hard trajectory-level filtering (drop bottom-p% rollouts by teacher log-prob) + soft token-level reweighting (teacher-confidence × student-confusion), arguing soft weighting beats hard token selection (cf. TIP); verl-based, with a multi-teacher math+code variant

items.title: trd
items.description: 2026.06 McGill / Mila / UT Austin (Jiang et al.) arXiv 2606.08432 TRD — Trajectory-Refined Distillation; diagnoses prefix failure of dense per-token OPD, refines student rollouts at trajectory level before distilling; verl-based, also applies to OPSD

items.title: OPRD
items.description: 2026.06 ZJU / Ant Group arXiv 2606.06021 OPRD — On-Policy Representation Distillation; first OPD to supervise in hidden-state space (aligns teacher/student representations across layers on student rollouts, bypassing the LM head) rather than logits; built on the THUNLP OPD stack

items.title: IW-OPD
items.description: 2026.06 Xidian / Georgia Tech / Amazon AGI SF Lab arXiv 2606.22600 · project IW-OPD — On the Position Bias of OPD; supervising only the prefix 30% of tokens matches full-token OPD while suffix-30% barely learns; reweights the OPD advantage by a prefix-importance term derived from a trust-region argument

items.title: ReNIO
items.description: 2026.06 ECNU / Shanghai Innovation Institute arXiv 2606.23104 ReNIO — Reweighting Negative Trajectory Importance; finds training on incorrect student outputs beats correct-only under both OPD and OPSD, then approximates correctness with a prefix-computable pivotal-token proxy

items.title: Direct-OPD
items.description: 2026.07 Tsinghua AIR SIA-Lab / ByteDance Seed / PKU arXiv 2607.05394 · project Direct-OPD — Weak-to-Strong Generalization; distills the teacher's implicit reward (post-RL minus pre-RL log-ratio) instead of its distribution, so a weaker post-RL teacher can improve a stronger student. Qwen3-1.7B AIME24 48.3→58.3 in ~4 h on 8×A100

items.title: OPD²
items.description: 2026.07 NAVER AI Lab arXiv 2607.15161 On-Policy Delta Distillation; replaces the teacher–student log-ratio reward with a delta signal (teacher minus its own base model), plus a sign-agreement gate. Qwen3-1.7B math avg 34.8→54.6

items.title: SimCT
items.description: 2026.05 Tencent Hunyuan / USTC / Shanghai Innovation Institute arXiv 2605.07711 SimCT — Recovering Lost Supervision for Cross-Tokenizer OPD; builds a common supervision space of shared-vocab tokens ∪ minimal aligned units (finest jointly-tokenizable spans) so the unchanged OPD loss applies across tokenizers

items.title: Prune-OPD
items.description: 2026.05 HKUST(GZ) / MBZUAI / UC Merced / SYSU arXiv 2605.07804 Prune-OPD — monitors per-position teacher/student top-k overlap, attenuates rewards on prefix drift and truncates once supervision is locally unexploitable; −37.6–68.0% training time. The mechanism KAT-Coder-V2.5 credits for its drift-aware truncation

items.title: TA-OPD
items.description: 2026.05 HK PolyU / InfiX.ai arXiv 2605.26844 Not All Disagreement Is Learnable — Token Teachability in OPD; supervises only a support-aligned "teachable" subset, matching or beating full-token OPD with 5–10% of tokens

items.title: TrOPD
items.description: 2026.06 Samsung Research Beijing / Oxford / PKU arXiv 2606.01249 Trust Region On-Policy Distillation; partitions student tokens into a teacher-verifiable trust region (reverse KL) vs outliers (top-k forward KL), plus annealed off-policy guidance. AIME25 44.06 vs OPD 40.72

items.title: ProteinOPD
items.description: 2026.05 Tsinghua / IDEA / HKUST(GZ) / NTU arXiv 2605.10189 ProteinOPD — multi-teacher OPD for protein language models; distills a normalized product-of-experts consensus over preference-specific teachers via token-level generalized JSD. PPL −83.7%, thermostability +54.2%

items.title: MAD-OPD
items.description: 2026.05 HUST / Alibaba arXiv 2605.01347 Breaking the Ceiling in OPD via Multi-Agent Debate; two larger teachers (K=2) debate across rounds to form the token-level target, with task-adaptive divergence. A 4B student beats its own 14B teacher on LiveCodeBench-v6

items.title: W2S-OPD
items.description: 2026.07 UMD / Microsoft Research / MBZUAI arXiv 2607.26246 · project W2S-OPD — Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation; synthesises a proxy teacher distribution by re-anchoring a weak contrast pair's logit delta onto the student's own base model, then distils it with per-token reverse KL. Three interchangeable contrast sources: post-RL vs pre-RL expert, larger vs smaller base model, correct vs wrong hints

items.title: Relay-OPD
items.description: 2026.07 Zhejiang Univ. / Yuvion Team, Alibaba arXiv 2607.26057 Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation — attacks prefix failure via a teacher–student continuation asymmetry on failed prefixes (the teacher redirects, the student ploughs on) used as a label-free handoff trigger: the teacher briefly writes a "teacher leg", the student resumes, and the relayed trajectory is distilled under a limited relay budget concentrating intervention early. +5.73% over OPD, +1.49% over FastOPD. Same diagnosis as TRD, different remedy (in-trajectory relay vs. post-hoc refinement)

items.title: OPD² (multilingual)
items.description: 2026.08 NAVER AI Lab arXiv 2608.05802 On-Policy Delta Distillation for Multilingual Math Reasoning — carries the OPD² delta signal into cross-lingual math (EN/KO/JA), where the teacher's absolute distribution is contaminated by language priors the student already holds. ⚠️ Shares both the OPD² name and the same repo as 2607.15161 — a companion second paper, not a replacement; the existing note about needing the teacher's pre-post-training base checkpoint applies here too

items.title: TIDE
items.description: 2026.08 HKU / USTC / CUHK arXiv 2608.09836 Mismatch Matters: OPD Beyond Token Agreement — splits teacher–student mismatch into excess mass (student over-commits) and deficit mass (student never proposes what the teacher wants), penalising the first with a Hellinger-shaped term and repairing the second by injecting teacher top-K tokens, arguing plain token agreement hides both failure modes. verl-based

items.title: SimpleOPD
items.description: 2026.08 Shanghai AI Laboratory (SU-01 Team) arXiv 2608.14277 SimpleOPD — Tokenizer-Agnostic OPD for Long-Context Reasoning — matches token log-probabilities across differing vocabularies with no alignment table, distilling a long-context teacher into a short-context student. Third cross-tokenizer entry alongside SimCT and 2607.22334, each with a different alignment construction

items.title: AED
items.description: 2026.08 Sun Yat-sen Univ. / Hong Kong Metropolitan Univ. arXiv 2608.14685 Rethinking Reverse KL as Adaptive Entropy Distillation — decomposes the reverse-KL OPD objective into a teacher-fitting term and a student-entropy term, then uses the teacher's own per-token entropy to calibrate imitation strength: high-entropy (uncertain-teacher) tokens get less forced imitation, low-entropy tokens more — with no explicit forward-KL branch. Full-vocab and teacher-top-k variants; MATH-500 Avg@8 14.63%→47.80% over vanilla RKL in one reported config

items.title: TA-OPD (tail-aware)
items.description: 2026.08 SUSTech (Statistics & Data Science) arXiv 2608.14728 Tail-Aware Top-k On-Policy Distillation — top-k teacher truncation silently discards the tail probability mass; TA-OPD keeps the aggregated tail as an explicit extra distillation target, in three variants (normalised top-k, TA-OPD, sample-corrected TA-OPD). verl/vLLM on DAPO-MATH-17K. ⚠️ Acronym collision with the listed TA-OPD (2605.26844, token Teachability, repo ) — different paper, different repo, different mechanism

items.title: Open-MOPD
items.description: 2026.08 SIA-Lab (Tsinghua AIR & ByteDance Seed) / Tsinghua arXiv 2608.19098 Open-MOPD — Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher OPD — the open reproduction of the Xiaomi MOPD recipe: diagnoses naive multi-teacher merging (math / code / instruction-following) as an optimization-budget imbalance rather than a capability conflict, and rebalances it — integration gap 3.50 → 0.31 points, recovering 83.4% of the achievable maximum on SmolLM3-3B. Ships 5 checkpoints + 3 domain RL teachers + data + full pipeline, making it the most reproducible multi-teacher OPD artifact in the list

items.title: 🔬 OPD with Larger External Teachers — White-Box

items.description: When the teacher is API-only (no logits), OPD uses scalar rewards, verbal scores, preferences, or adversarial discriminators — all evaluated on student rollouts. Entries that turned out to use static teacher data only (Lion, SuperCorrect, DAIL, SODA) are excluded from this list.

items.title: LMOps
items.description: 2025.11 Microsoft Research arXiv 2511.10643 · project GAD — Black-Box OPD

items.title: SPoT
items.description: 2026.03 Visual-AI arXiv 2603.01683 SPOT: Surgical Post-Training — black-box oracle edits student failures into proximal rollouts

items.title: ROPD
items.description: 2026.05 NUS / USTC / Tencent arXiv 2605.07396 ROPD — Rubric-based On-Policy Distillation; induces prompt-specific rubrics from teacher–student contrasts, then scores student rollouts by those rubrics (logit-free / black-box); up to 10× sample efficiency

items.title: PRISM
items.description: 2026.04 HKUST(GZ) / Tsinghua / NTU / RUC / USTC / UCAS arXiv 2604.28123 PRISM — Pre-alignment via Black-Box OPD for Multimodal RL; an adversarial OPD stage inserted between SFT and RLVR, scoring student rollouts with a Mixture-of-Experts discriminator (separate perception and reasoning experts, Bradley–Terry loss). +4.4 / +6.0 avg over SFT→RLVR at 4B / 8B

items.title: ExpRL
items.description: 2026.06 Stanford / CMU arXiv 2606.17024 ExpRL — Exploratory RL for LLM Mid-Training; an LLM judge scores the student’s own rollouts and prefixes against a hidden reference solution under a fixed rubric, giving dense process-level reward before sparse RL ⚠️ see strictness note

items.title: 🎭 OPD with Black-Box / Outcome-Based Teachers

items.description:
Same model = teacher = student, but the teacher is conditioned on something the student doesn't see (verified trace, ground-truth answer, "be concise" prefix, longer context, document, …). The gap exists because of the conditioning, not weights.
Several entries previously listed here turned out on verification to use static teacher data or a fixed self-rewritten dataset rather than student rollouts; those have been excluded. SPIN was reclassified to Iterative Self-Bootstrapping.

items.title: COPSD
items.description: 2026.05 LMU Munich / MCML arXiv 2605.09548 COPSD — crosslingual OPSD; teacher sees English problem translation + reference solution, student rolls out in low-resource language (17 African languages)

items.title: SGSD
items.description: 2026.05 THU arXiv 2605.28791 SGSD — Skill-Conditional Gated SD

items.title: CrashBugger/CODE
items.description: 2026.05 USTC arXiv 2605.28303 CODE — OPSD on Knowledge Editing + Casual Editing

items.title: RLCSD
items.description: 2026.06 THU (BPM) / Alibaba Tongyi arXiv 2606.11709 RLCSD — Contrastive OPSD; cancels privilege-induced style drift by contrasting the teacher–student gap under a correct hint vs. a wrong hint; verl-based

items.title: d-OPSD
items.description: 2026.06 THU / TUM / NTU / UT Austin arXiv 2606.18195 d-OPSD — first OPSD for diffusion LLMs; self-generated answers as suffix conditioning ("self future-experience"); step-level (not token-level) divergence aligned to the denoising process

items.title: CaOPD
items.description: 2026.04 Salesforce AI Research arXiv 2604.16830 CaOPD — The Illusion of Certainty; proves privileged conditioning makes the teacher's confidence a non-identifiable and upward-biased target, so OPD reliably buys accuracy at the cost of severe overconfidence; fixes it by rewriting confidence targets to the free empirical rollout success rate

items.title: Vision-OPD
items.description: 2026.05 ISCAS / UCAS / Xiaohongshu arXiv 2605.18740 Vision-OPD — regional-to-global OPSD for MLLM fine detail; teacher sees a 2×-upscaled evidence crop, student sees the full image. 9B beats Gemini-3.1-Pro on the fine-grained suite using 6.2K fully synthetic triplets, no GT labels or verifier

items.title: D-OPSD
items.description: 2026.05 HKUST / Z-Image Team Alibaba / UCSD / CUHK arXiv 2605.05204 D-OPSD — OPSD for continuously tuning step-distilled diffusion models; exploits that LLM/VLM-encoder T2I models inherit in-context ability, so feeding the encoder the target image is free privileged context

items.title: PW-OPSD
items.description: 2026.05 SaFo Lab / UW–Madison arXiv 2605.21606 PW-OPSD — When Are Teacher Tokens Reliable?; a branch-viability diagnostic shows position separates genuinely-uncertain from merely-diverse teacher tokens (AUROC 0.83) where every local uncertainty measure fails (≤0.57)

items.title: OPSD Predictive Law
items.description: 2026.05 Tufa Labs, Zürich arXiv 2605.30070 A Predictive Law for OPSD From World Feedback — the pre-training student–self-teacher accuracy gap linearly predicts final OPSD gain (R² 0.949 / 0.996), so privileged-context designs can be screened before training (ICML RLxF 2026)

items.title: Visual-OPSD
items.description: 2026.06 XJTU (MOE KLINNS) / SYSU arXiv 2606.18974 Visual-OPSD — shows a unified multimodal model's rendered "visual thoughts" matter as a generation pathway, not as pixels, then distills that pathway into a text-only student: +3.40 pp over its own teacher at 14.3× speedup

items.title: Denser ≠ Better
items.description: 2026.07 HKISI CAS / CASIA / UCAS / NJUST arXiv 2607.01763 Denser ≠ Better: Limits of OPSD for Continual Post-Training — SDPO specialises harder than GRPO but forgets far more (ToolUse −80% vs GRPO +18%); dense self-distillation is a specialisation accelerator, not a continual-learning stabiliser

items.title: Rethinking OPSD
items.description: 2026.07 Princeton PLI (Kaur, Ri, He, Fowl, Arora) arXiv 2607.05184 Rethinking OPSD for Thinking Models — privileged self-distillation degrades all five thinking models tested (up to −17% rel.), while the same students improve under unprivileged OPD; mechanism is fork suppression of self-correction cues

items.title: dOPSD
items.description: 2026.07 NUS arXiv 2607.04428 dOPSD — OPSD for diffusion LMs; privilege comes from later, more-decoded steps of the student's own denoising trajectory ("peek-ahead"), needing no reference solution. Only method beating base on all four benchmarks where SFT and GRPO both degrade

items.title: vOPD
items.description: 2026.05 Seoul National University arXiv 2605.07865 KL for a KL — OPD with Control Variate Baseline; derives the OPD value function in closed form as the per-token negative reverse KL (already computed in the forward pass) and subtracts it as an unbiased variance-reducing baseline. −57.7% wall-clock vs full-vocab KL

items.title: OPHSD
items.description: 2026.05 PKU arXiv 2605.08741 Training with Harnesses — On-Policy Harness Self-Distillation; the privileged context is an inference-time programmatic harness (draft-verify, plan-solve with oracle) rather than a text hint. +10.83% over OPSD on HMMT25

items.title: AntiSD
items.description: 2026.05 Xiaohongshu / CASIA arXiv 2605.11609 Anti-Self-Distillation via Pointwise Mutual Information; deliberately ascends JSD (sign-reversed vs normal self-distillation) under an entropy gate. Reaches GRPO’s peak in 2–10× fewer steps, up to +11.5 avg

items.title: Multi-Rollout OPD
items.description: 2026.05 Microsoft / CMU / Purdue arXiv 2605.12652 Multi-Rollout OPD via Peer Successes and Failures; conditions the self-teacher on peer rollouts from the same group — successes as demonstrations, failures as contrastive evidence. AIME25 mean@8 25.41 vs SDPO 7.81

items.title: RESD
items.description: 2026.05 UC San Diego / Amazon / Georgia Tech arXiv 2605.12741 Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation; enriches the teacher context with a retrospective reflection plus a persistent cross-step playbook of reusable lessons, learning from rare successes at 1 rollout/prompt

items.title: OPSA
items.description: 2026.05 UC Riverside / ICSI / Microsoft / Berkeley Lab arXiv 2605.15239 Reducing the Safety Tax with OPSD; a type-conditional privileged context (harmful→refusal steering, benign→helpfulness steering) selected by teacher flip rate. +4.00 safety AND +3.04 reasoning — no tax

items.title: SafeSteer
items.description: 2026.06 Beihang / BIT / BUPT / PKU / CASIA / Shanghai AI Lab / BAAI arXiv 2606.02530 Localized OPD for Safety Alignment; privilege is an activation-level refusal steering vector injected into the residual stream, with KL restricted to a 50-token safety subset. ASR 2.87%→0.91% using only 100 harmful samples

items.title: COPSD (Constitutional)
items.description: 2026.06 Fudan / Shanghai Innovation Institute / Ant Group / ZJU / CityU HK arXiv 2606.03089 Constitutional On-Policy Safe Distillation; teacher conditioned on a safety constitution, with a Cross-SFT cold start first fixing the constitution-induced distributional collapse ⚠️ name collides with crosslingual COPSD

items.title: DistIL
items.description: 2026.06 USC arXiv 2606.05152 RL from Rich Feedback with Distributional DAgger; unlike ordinary DAgger the forward-CE loss lands on the student’s own visited states, with a future-aware credit term, and comes with a monotonic-improvement guarantee

items.title: OPDLM
items.description: 2026.06 Texas A&M / UTHealth Houston arXiv 2606.06712 Autoregressive-to-Diffusion LMs via OPD; the frozen ARLM run in its native causal mode is the privileged teacher for a diffusion student sampling its own denoising trajectories. 15×–7,000× fewer training tokens than from-scratch DLMs

items.title: AR-OPD
items.description: 2026.06 SCUT arXiv 2606.10385 Anchored Residual Guidance for Privileged OPD; combats hindsight leakage by contrasting a partial-privilege anchor against a full-privilege teacher into a residual target. Shortcut events −21.7%

items.title: RCSD
items.description: 2026.06 Yale arXiv 2606.19327 Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation; Stage I learns a rubric generator by OPSD, Stage II conditions the teacher on that learned rubric — replacing single-reference alignment with criterion-level guidance

items.title: LOPD
items.description: 2026.08 NUS / BUPT / SJTU arXiv 2608.13040 Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation — makes the privileged context learnable: retrieved experiences are composed into continuous latent tokens conditioning the self-teacher, rather than hand-crafted answers/hints/skills. Dense token-level supervision at every visited prefix plus a privileged-margin objective that stabilises learning of the latent context itself. Ships Qwen3-8B-LOPD and OLMo3-7B-Think-LOPD checkpoints. Cross-listed into Agent

items.title: SSPO
items.description: 2026.08 HKUST / Huawei arXiv 2608.12764 Beyond Outcome Rewards: Step-Level Self-Distilled Policy Optimization for Deep Search Agents — privileged context is "Evidence Anchors", concise step-level evidence snippets extracted from the web that reveal key reasoning steps without exposing the full answer path. Teacher–student disagreement under those anchors becomes step-level GRPO advantage weights applied only to incorrect trajectories — avoiding the information asymmetry that naive full-answer privilege induces

items.title: USD
items.description: 2026.08 Tencent (Workbuddy) / Zhejiang Univ. arXiv 2608.08176 Matching Supervision to the Student's Learning Capacity — formalises token-weighting and privileged-information strength as coupled variables under a shared student-learning-capacity budget, solving the Lagrangian online so a single dual variable sets both the token-selection threshold and the privilege-adjustment direction. Built on TRL's GOLD trainer

items.title: RP-OPSD (reasoning-pivot)
items.description: 2026.08 NJUNLP, Nanjing University arXiv 2608.06347 Reasoning-Pivot-Guided OPSD for Multilingual Reasoning Transfer — contrasts matched teacher views with and without the English reference to isolate "reasoning pivots" (decision tokens that redirect reasoning) rather than surface text tokens, concentrating distillation weight on reasoning-control tokens. 17 languages. In the MSD / COPSD crosslingual lineage. ⚠️ Acronym collision with RP-OPSD (2607.24447, Resolution-Privileged)

items.title: U-OPSD
items.description: 2026.08 UC San Diego / Georgia Tech / UMD / ByteDance arXiv 2608.06296 On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision — no ground truth, no external feedback, no larger model: samples multiple rollouts, forms a pseudo-solution by majority vote under a self-consistency threshold, conditions the model on that pseudo-solution as the privileged view, and distils onto the disagreeing completions — correcting the model precisely where it is confidently wrong. +8.5% / +10.7% over base at 4B/8B on Qwen3

items.title: DASH
items.description: 2026.08 Institute of Automation CAS / EverMind / UCAS / Wuhan AI Research arXiv 2608.06243 DASH — Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons — standard OPSD under-exploits the temporal structure of a rollout; DASH maps the gap between each local distillation signal and the sequence-level mean into an adaptive propagation gate, then uses backward multi-step aggregation for path-dependent rather than uniform token supervision. LoRA weights released for Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B

items.title: OCSD
items.description: 2026.08 Meituan LongCat Interaction arXiv 2608.04788 Agentic RL with Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation — privileged context is future environment observations replayed into the teacher. Identifies a confound: support from the privileged replay reflects both the privileged information and score shifts caused by the replay scaffold itself. OCSD contrasts two structurally matched views (Full vs. Observation-Ablated) to isolate an "observation residual" that discounts the scaffold component, then modulates token-level GRPO updates with it

items.title: SPEE
items.description: 2026.08 Renmin University (Gaoling) / Tencent WeChat AI arXiv 2608.02139 Self-Improving LLMs via Progressive Experience Evolution — two stages: (1) reflect on trajectories from multiple interactions to extract, verify and evolve transferable experience summaries; (2) internalise them via privilege-guided OPSD, the experience-conditioned self-teacher scoring the student's own rollouts, followed by ordinary reward-driven RL. ⚠️ Stage 2 is plain GRPO and not itself OPSD

items.title: OPD-V
items.description: 2026.08 LMU Munich / MCML / NUS / Sun Yat-sen Univ. arXiv 2608.05131 OPD-V — Visual OPSD with Modality Balance — a "Positive Teacher" conditioned on a zoomed-in image and a "Negative Teacher" conditioned on a masked image, both the same MLLM under different privileged visual input. Treats Modality Imbalance (text dominating generation) as itself exploitable privilege, defining a Modality-Balance Trust Region from the positive/negative logit margins to select which on-policy tokens get distilled. 6 benchmarks, 4 MLLM backbones. ⚠️ Near-collision with the listed OPSD-V (2607.08766). Cross-listed into Multimodal

items.title: HPSD
items.description: 2026.08 SJTU / NTU S-Lab / Fudan / USTC / CUHK / Shanghai AI Lab / Adobe / JD.com arXiv 2608.13205 HPSD — Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation for Text-Image-to-Video Diffusion — the teacher runs in TI2V mode with a high-quality first frame plus an enhanced prompt; the student runs plain T2V with the vanilla prompt (same unified model). The student inherits teacher trajectory points as anchors, locally refines them toward its own denoising policy, and receives velocity-level supervision on those self-generated rollouts. ⚠️ C1 only partially holds — the anchor states come from the teacher's trajectory; see strictness notes. Cross-listed into Multimodal

Bootstraps with a prompt-switched brevity SFT pass, then runs CRISP-style OPSD. Qwen3-8B MATH-500 86.2%→92.0% while length drops 3,099→1,115 tokens

items.description: Same model is the teacher, but as a frozen earlier checkpoint, not a privileged-context view. Listed separately because the supervision is typically sequence-level / preference, not per-token logit-distillation.

items.title: UCOB

items.description: 2026.07 Nankai / Zhongguancun Academy / BIT / ZJU / CASIA / HIT arXiv 2607.17247 Distilled RL; drops the KL loss entirely and injects the teacher as a reverse importance ratio on the GRPO advantage, with a negative-sample reset and sequence-level geometric normalisation so the teacher only redistributes credit

items.title: CEPO
items.description: 2026.05 MBZUAI / Linköping / ANU arXiv 2605.19436 Contrastive Evidence Policy Optimization; replaces RLSD’s single privileged-answer ratio with a contrastive one (correct-answer teacher vs rejected-peer teacher), provably leakage-free

items.title: LGR
items.description: 2026.05 UCAS / ISCAS / Xiaohongshu arXiv 2605.30833 Combating Supervision Fidelity Decay in OPD; adds a Lookahead Group Reward over top-K candidate tokens using teacher confidence one step ahead, with entropy-triggered tree attention

items.title: SDPG
items.description: 2026.06 UCLA / Princeton AI Lab arXiv 2606.04036 Self-Distilled Policy Gradient; GRPO plus an exact full-vocabulary reverse-KL self-distillation term, positive-advantage-masked and warmup-decayed

items.title: Tokenizer Barrier
items.description: 2026.06 HKUST(GZ) / Tencent arXiv 2606.09456 Breaking the Tokenizer Barrier: OPD across Model Families; dual-pointer chunk alignment projects a different-family teacher’s chunk log-probability onto mismatched student tokens. Matches same-tokenizer OPD gains at ~4% of the FLOPs of equivalent SFT scaling

items.title: MemOPD
items.description: 2026.08 PKU / Zhejiang / HIT arXiv 2608.07068 MemOPD — PPO with a reverse-KL term from an external teacher, aimed at the state-mismatch problem in long-horizon memory compression: the student is scored on the compressed states it actually reaches rather than on teacher-generated ones

items.title: GC-OPD
items.description: 2026.08 Tsinghua / BUPT / OpenBMB arXiv 2608.19181 Beyond Teacher Likelihood: Group-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning — a PPO surrogate on the teacher-log-prob advantage corrected by a verifier-reward residual, calibrated across the rollout group so that high teacher likelihood alone cannot dominate credit on long-context traces

items.title: OPDVR
items.description: 2026.08 LeapLab Tsinghua / Beihang / PKU / NLPLab Tsinghua arXiv 2608.24696 On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward — a verifier-gated ReLU on the teacher log-ratio feeds a GRPO-style policy gradient: on correct rollouts and on incorrect ones, so the teacher is only trusted in the direction the verifier endorses

items.title: 🤝 OPD-RL Hybrids — Inside-RL OPD

items.description:
Genuine OPD work on math / code / long-CoT reasoning. Off-policy SFT-distill from R1, pure RL methods (Skywork-OR1, SimpleRL-Zoo, Time-R1), and analysis-only papers are excluded from this list — each had no student-rollout-with-teacher-supervision component.
The reasoning-OPD canon already lives across OPSD (siyan-zhao/OPSD, CRISP, SD-Zero), Iterative Self-Bootstrapping (rStar / rStar-Math), OPD-RL Hybrids (LUFFY, RLAD, KDRL, RLSD, HDPO), and White-Box (REOPOLD, Fast OPD, Entropy-Aware OPD, TIP, SCOPE, PACED). This section only lists items not already covered above.

items.title: Flow-OPD
items.description: 2026.05 Multi-org arXiv 2605.08063 Flow-OPD — first to integrate OPD into Flow-Matching text-to-image models; consolidates multiple single-reward GRPO expert teachers into one student via on-policy sampling + reverse-KL (SD-3.5-Medium)

items.title: Decomposed-OPD
items.description: 2026.06 KAIST / Microsoft Research Asia arXiv 2606.00564 Decomposed-OPD / VGS — decomposes the OPD gradient into (near-orthogonal) language-prior vs. visual-grounding components; Visual Gradient Steering reorients updates toward the visual subspace for VLM reasoning

items.title: DiffusionOPD
items.description: 2026.05 Fudan / Wan Team, Alibaba arXiv 2605.15055 DiffusionOPD — A Unified Perspective of OPD in Diffusion Models; lifts token-level KL to a continuous-state Markov chain where identical kernel covariance collapses reverse KL into closed-form L2 transition matching, consolidating multiple single-reward RL experts. Avg 0.929 vs 0.851 Cascade NFT at ~⅔ the GPU-hours

items.title: Vision-OPD
items.description: 2026.05 ISCAS / UCAS / Xiaohongshu arXiv 2605.18740 Vision-OPD — regional-to-global OPSD for fine visual detail (cross-list with OPSD)

items.title: Visual-OPSD
items.description: 2026.06 XJTU / SYSU arXiv 2606.18974 Visual-OPSD — internalises rendered "visual thoughts" into a text-only student; +3.40 pp over its own teacher at 14.3× speedup (cross-list with OPSD)

items.title: V-Zero
items.description: 2026.06 Sichuan Univ. / XJTU / TeleAI / PKU arXiv 2606.25319 V-Zero — Answer-Label-Free OPD with Contrastive Evidence Gating; the teacher replays the student's tokens under a positive question-relevant crop and a negative off-region crop, and the log-likelihood gap gates the OPD loss. No answer labels, verifiable rewards, or inference-time tools

items.title: H-OPD
items.description: 2026.07 BUPT / ByteDance / USTC / Zhongguancun Academy arXiv 2607.02592 H-OPD — Confidence-Aware Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher Multimodal OPD; replaces sample-level teacher routing with token-level arbitration between a vision-language teacher and a text-only teacher fed a precomputed image description

items.title: OPSD-V
items.description: 2026.07 Meituan (MeiGen) / HKUST / CityU HK arXiv 2607.08766 OPSD-V — OPSD for few-step autoregressive video generators; real long videos become privileged temporal context in the teacher's KV cache rather than reconstruction targets, fixing long-horizon drift at unchanged NFE

items.title: Med-OPD
items.description: 2026.07 NUS / USTC arXiv 2607.16303 Med-OPD — Evidence-Aware OPD for Medical VLMs; counterfactually degrades the image to isolate which tokens actually depend on imaging evidence (top 10% carry ~88% of the signal), then reweights the KL accordingly

items.title: VISD
items.description: 2026.05 HUST / WHU / PKU / Tsinghua arXiv 2605.06094 Structured Self-Distillation for Video Reasoning; an EMA self-teacher conditioned on a video-aware judge’s correctness + temporal/spatial grounding modulates advantage magnitude while the rule reward sets direction. Matches VisionCoach with ~50% of its steps

items.title: AnyFlow
items.description: 2026.05 NVIDIA / Show Lab NUS / MIT arXiv 2605.13724 Any-Step Video Diffusion via On-Policy Flow Map Distillation; the student rolls out its own flow-map backward simulation and a frozen teacher supplies DMD-style reverse-divergence supervision. VBench 84.05 at 4 NFEs

items.title: ViCuR
items.description: 2026.06 Shanghai AI Lab / Fudan / Nanjing Univ. arXiv 2606.05718 Visual Cues as Recoverable Privilege; privileges only cues derivable from the same input, with a sink-token module letting the student internally recover them — the direct answer to privilege the student can never reproduce

items.title: Imagine-OPD
items.description: 2026.06 PKU / CSU / USTC / Huawei arXiv 2606.08719 Thinking Without Images; teacher sees privileged zoomed-in ground-truth crops, student reasons from the full image only. Beats explicit tool-call "thinking with images" baselines at 1.5–2.7× faster inference

items.title: GNDPO
items.description: 2026.06 OPPO AI Center arXiv 2606.09091 Stabilizing OPD for MLLM Reasoning with Global Normalization; fixes gradient explosions from OOD low-probability teacher tokens by batch-normalizing KL rewards into relative advantages under a GSPO-style clip

items.title: ViGOS
items.description: 2026.06 SIA CAS / UCAS arXiv 2606.19120 Seeing Before Reasoning; two different teachers supervise different segments of one rollout — an image-only perception teacher for the description, an answer-privileged teacher for the reasoning. Mean Pass@5 68.13→75.60

items.title: WMSD
items.description: 2026.06 University of Bern arXiv 2606.12072 World Model Self-Distillation; a video-diffusion Executor samples its own rollouts and a Demonstrator teacher conditioned on a privileged detailed execution description gives per-timestep velocity supervision. The Executor surpasses its own teacher

items.title: PF-OPSD
items.description: 2026.06 Univ. of Macau / LIGHTSPEED arXiv 2606.03603 World Models Meet Language Models; a privileged evaluator that sees the ground-truth future video scores the student’s own trajectories, teaching the MLLM when to invoke and trust a video world model. +10.6/+10.9 over SFT

items.title: InternVideo3
items.description: 2026.06 Shanghai AI Lab / Shanghai Innovation Institute / Nanjing Univ. arXiv 2606.12195 InternVideo3; OPD is the final stage of a 4-stage recipe, applied to examples filtered for a teacher>student gap. Best open-weight Video-MME 73.8

items.title: Veritas++
items.description: 2026.07 UCAS / CASIA / Ant Group / Sangfor arXiv 2607.27113 Veritas++ — privileged self-teacher for AIGI detection. After grounding perception with verifiable-reward RL (PoRL), a privileged self-teacher internalises perception-aware reasoning over the student's own reasoning chain via value-weighted OPD KL

items.title: VAD
items.description: 2026.07 SJTU / Xiaohongshu arXiv 2607.28590 VAD — counterfactual visual-evidence-attributed OPD. Standard privileged-view corrections are source-mixed (visual signal + linguistic prior + format). At each student-generated prefix VAD evaluates the same fixed teacher with and without the visual evidence, reconstructing an evidence-attributed target so only the genuinely visual part of the correction is distilled

items.title: OPD-V
items.description: 2026.08 LMU Munich / MCML / NUS / Sun Yat-sen Univ. arXiv 2608.05131 OPD-V — modality-balance-gated visual OPSD. Treats Modality Imbalance (text dominating generation, visual input underused) as itself exploitable privilege: positive teacher sees a zoomed-in image, negative teacher a masked one, and their logit margin defines a Modality-Balance Trust Region selecting which on-policy tokens get distilled. ⚠️ Near-collision with OPSD-V (2607.08766). Cross-listed from OPSD

items.title: ADOPD
items.description: 2026.08 Zhejiang University arXiv 2608.09789 ADOPD — reference-privileged industrial-anomaly MLLM OPD. The teacher evaluates the same student-generated rollout twice, once under a matched and once under a mismatched defect reference, and the reference gap weights the token-level KL — isolating what the reference genuinely contributes. ⚠️ Topically adjacent to the listed OPD-IAD (2607.18850) but independent concurrent work: disjoint authors, different privileging mechanism

items.title: HPSD
items.description: 2026.08 SJTU / NTU S-Lab / Fudan / USTC / CUHK / Shanghai AI Lab / Adobe / JD.com arXiv 2608.13205 HPSD — hybrid-policy self-distillation for TI2V diffusion. One model plays both roles: teacher in TI2V mode (privileged first frame + enhanced prompt), student in plain T2V. ⚠️ C1 only partially holds — anchor states come from the teacher's trajectory and only the K-step continuation is student-generated; see strictness notes. Cross-listed from OPSD

items.title: CMD
items.description: 2026.08 NVIDIA / University of Surrey arXiv 2608.13391 CMD — causal DMD video distillation with Prefix Scoring. Existing causal-student DMD pipelines score against a bidirectional teacher that sees future frames the student never has; CMD's Prefix Scoring "matches supervision to the student's realized rollout context", evaluating the causal teacher on the cached student-realized prefix. The cleanest C1/C2 in this cohort

items.title: S²VOPD
items.description: 2026.08 UC San Diego / UMD / Oxford / JHU / Georgia Tech arXiv 2608.14144 Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation — inverts where the asymmetry comes from: instead of adding privileged information to the teacher, it degrades the student's view and distils against the undegraded-view self-teacher, with an all-augmentation-family study of which degradations carry signal

items.description: Genuine OPD where the student is an agent rolling out actions; teacher (or self) supervises those trajectories. Pure-RL agent works (WebRL, WebAgent-R1, InfiGUI-G1, GUI-R1) and off-policy SFT-on-teacher-trajectories (Nardien, AgentRefine, Chain-of-Agents, MapCoder-Lite, SAD, Structured-Web) are excluded.

items.title: SDAR
items.description: 2026.05 ZJU-REAL / Meituan arXiv 2605.15155 SDAR — Self-Distilled Agentic RL; multi-turn agent rolls out, a privileged-context self-teacher gives gated token-level OPSD as an auxiliary objective while RL stays the primary backbone (ALFWorld, WebShop, Search-QA)

items.title: KbSD
items.description: 2026.06 ZJU / PKU arXiv 2606.29863 KbSD — Knowledge Boundary aware Self-Distillation; a structured boundary hint (parametric certainty, semantic stability, retrieval quality) is privileged context, and the divergence direction itself is chosen per behavioural quadrant. Unreliability rate −17 points at both 3B and 7B

items.title: SEED
items.description: 2026.07 Tsinghua / ZJU / CUHK / NTU / Tongji arXiv 2607.14777 SEED — Self-Evolving OPD for Agentic RL; the policy becomes its own trajectory analyzer, converting completed rollouts into hindsight skills that condition a self-teacher. ALFWorld 91.8 vs 75.0 GRPO and 84.4 SDAR; matches full-data GRPO with 60% of the data

items.title: ReOPD
items.description: 2026.07 Microsoft Research / Univ. of Amsterdam arXiv 2607.04763 ReOPD — Multi-Turn OPD with Prefix Replay; reuses pre-collected teacher prefixes so the student acts at one step per sample and never queries the environment (zero tool calls, ≥4× faster). Beats fully online OPD on math (57.2 vs 55.1) ⚠️ see strictness note

items.title: UI-MOPD
items.description: 2026.07 Tsinghua SIGS / Xiaomi / HIT-SZ / ZJU / Peng Cheng Lab arXiv 2607.04425 UI-MOPD — Multi-Platform OPD for Continual GUI Agents; replaces GRPO's KL term with a platform-routed teacher penalty, masked off wherever task reward is already strong. Fixes the cross-platform forgetting that makes single-platform SFT collapse the other platform to 0%

items.title: GUI-SD
items.description: 2026.05 IIE CAS / Nankai arXiv 2605.00642 Learn where to Click from Yourself — first OPSD for GUI grounding; teacher gets visually privileged context (ground-truth bbox + Gaussian soft-mask zoom) and supervision is positionally-weighted reverse KL per coordinate digit token. ScreenSpot-Pro 60.7% at 4× faster training than GRPO

items.title: SOD
items.description: 2026.05 Tencent / ZJU / USTC / NUS arXiv 2605.07725 Step-wise OPD for Small Language Model Agents; step weights from the ratio of consecutive per-step divergences attenuate supervision after tool-call errors cause drift. A 0.6B student reaches 26.13% avg@32 on AIME 2025

items.title: MGSD
items.description: 2026.06 Tsinghua / HKUST arXiv 2606.06076 Modality-Gap-Aware Self-Distillation; a frozen text-only teacher conditioned on privileged symbolic state supervises an image-conditioned student, with symbolic context discarded at inference. Macro avg 17.2→35.6

items.title: OPD-Evolver
items.description: 2026.06 LV-NUS Lab / Fudan / PKU / ByteDance arXiv 2606.17628 Cultivating Holistic Agent Evolver via OPD; outcome-calibrated memory-value attribution turns delayed reward into hindsight context for a privileged teacher over a 4-tier agent memory. 9B beats Step-3.5-Flash (196B) on 9/10 subsets

items.title: EviSD
items.description: 2026.08 — arXiv 2608.01359 EviSD — Evidence-Conditioned Self-Distillation for Search-Augmented Agents. The student samples search/answer actions from its ordinary context; the same model then re-scores those identical actions as a privileged teacher under an evidence-augmented (for search actions) or gold-answer-augmented (for answer actions) context, and the bounded teacher–student gap is added to the outcome-derived GRPO advantage, localised to the action span. Recipes for 7B/3B/1.7B on SDAR/verl-agent/Search-R1

items.title: FutureBridge-OPD
items.description: 2026.08 — arXiv 2608.01953 Look Ahead Before You Distill — in vanilla OPD the student's deviations accumulate across a multi-turn trajectory, carrying it away from states where teacher guidance still helps. FTB detects high-disagreement states in the student's own rollout, executes a short teacher bridge, and validates that bridge by checking the resulting student continuation — a look-ahead test rather than blind trust. ALFWorld / WebShop / ScienceWorld, Qwen3-1.7B ← Qwen3-32B, VERL/Ray/vLLM

items.title: AgentOPSD
items.description: 2026.08 — arXiv 2608.05987 AgentOPSD — recursive Bayesian turn-level credit from self-distillation gaps. Critic-free: aggregates token-level teacher–student log-prob gaps (privileged self-teacher on the student's own rollout) into turn-level evidence, then recursively updates a Bayesian belief state in log-odds space to identify pivotal turns — no extra rollouts, no value network. ALFWorld / WebShop / Search-QA

items.title: LOPD
items.description: 2026.08 NUS / BUPT / SJTU arXiv 2608.13040 Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation — retrieved experiences composed into continuous latent tokens condition the self-teacher, replacing hand-crafted answers/hints/skills; a privileged-margin objective stabilises learning of the latent context itself. Tool-use and code. Cross-listed from OPSD

items.title: SecOPD
items.description: 2026.08 UC Berkeley arXiv 2608.21500 SecOPD — Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation. The student rolls out under the attacked (injected) prompt; a frozen initialization-checkpoint teacher scores the identical generated tokens under the clean version of that same prompt, and the log-prob gap becomes a per-token advantage. A neat use of privileged context as a security signal. Genuinely trains (LoRA + PPO-style token advantage), not an inference-time filter

items.description:
Distillation of the draft model so it better mimics the verifier/target. The on-policy element here is over the drafter's own continuations as judged by the target. Listed separately because the goal is inference speedup, not student capability.
This section only lists drafters trained with the drafter's own rollouts. Off-policy drafter training (EAGLE-1/2, Medusa, Hydra, Kangaroo, ReDrafter, BiTA, SpecDec++, LayerSkip, FREE, AdaSPEC, POSS) and training-free system tricks (Ouroboros, Sequoia, TriForce, SwiftKV, SuffixDecoding) are excluded.

items.title: PIPO
items.description: 2026.05 RUC / Xiaohongshu / UESTC / CASIA arXiv 2605.27255 Pair-In, Pair-Out — Latent Multi-Token Prediction; the compressed-pair drafter is trained by OPD against the uncompressed backbone, and a confidence head is learned for free from the same probability ratio the SD acceptance test uses — removing the verifier forward pass. 2.64× TTFT

items.title: AngelSpec
items.description: 2026.07 Tencent (Hunyuan AI Infra) arXiv 2607.25852 AngelSpec — open drafter-training framework; unifies 6 draft architectures (DFly, DFlash, DFlare, EAGLE-3, DSpark, MTP) under config-level switching. EAGLE-3-style Training-Time-Test self-unroll: "the module at depth k+1 receives the arg max prediction produced by its depth-k invocation instead of the ground-truth token", with the frozen target head supplying a per-depth teacher distribution and a depth-weighted KL. Disaggregated RDMA hidden-state streaming; online genuine-SD eval against the live checkpoint. Parallel to SpecForge

items.description: 2026.06 FuriosaAI (+ Ajou / Berkeley / MSR / KRAFTON) arXiv 2606.24143 AsyncOPD — How Stale Can OPD Be?; fully asynchronous rollout ∥ teacher-scoring ∥ learner pipeline. Finds forward KL is staleness-robust while reverse KL is not, and that recomputing the RKL signal under the current student beats generic async-RL fixes. 1.6–3.8× throughput

items.description: 2026.07 USTC / Tencent / Shanghai Innovation Institute / NUS arXiv 2607.11012 EasyOPD — verl-based unified OPD framework; factors the method landscape into five extension points (loss, rollout metadata, reward, tokenizer alignment, teacher sidecar) so cross-tokenizer OPD, OPSD and step-wise OPD share one backend, selected by YAML

items.title: EffOPD
items.description: 2026.05 USTC / Tencent / SHU / NUS / HKUST(GZ) / IIE-UCAS arXiv 2605.11739 Learning to Foresee — shows OPD updates are low-rank and early-stabilized ("foresight") unlike RL, then extrapolates along the early update direction to cut training steps ~3×

items.title: SAfactory
items.description: 2026.05 Shanghai AI Laboratory / DeepLink arXiv 2605.06230 SAfactory — agent-safety infrastructure whose Autonomous Evolution Platform ships an optional OPD plugin (teacher token log-probs + reverse-KL regularization inside agentic RL) ⚠️ OPD is one module, with no standalone ablation

items.title: mini-verl
items.description: 2026.08 Independent (DaoyuanLi2816) whole repo; PyPI mini-verl — dependency-light verl-style OPD runnable on a single consumer GPU (tested RTX 4080, Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B); consumes verl-shaped YAML + Parquet prompts. README states the loop verbatim as "actor rollout → teacher scoring → actor update". Deliberately narrow: one actor–teacher pair, one response per prompt, LoRA/QLoRA, no PPO / Ray / multi-GPU

SWE-Bench Verified 70.7

items.title: Intern-S2-Preview
items.description: 2026.08 Shanghai AI Laboratory arXiv 2608.13505 · HF · xtuner Intern-S2-Preview — scientific agentic foundation model; pipeline = SFT → scalable multi-task RL → black-/white-box agentic RL → OPD as the final consolidation stage, routing each query to a reasoning- or agentic-domain teacher. "the student policy π_θ first generates an on-policy trajectory y... OPD provides dense token-level supervision from the corresponding expert throughout the generated trajectory"; transmits only the sampled-token teacher log-probability, not full logits, and reports that this suffices for stability. Cross-listed into Multimodal
